claims.statement: LunaNexa is a provider-neutral model and GPU-cluster control plane, not a MoonSuite application or agent runtime.
Managed GPU nodes receive the LunaNexa node agent, approved runtime containers, signed model artifacts, and bounded telemetry—not application repositories or product credentials.
limitations: Live image and runtime-environment scans remain part of physical-cluster acceptance.

claims.statement: The repository implements controller, scheduling, enrollment, registry, workspace authority, deployment operations, Rabbita sites, client transport, and recovery evidence baselines.
limitations: Implementation is not equivalent to real four-node production acceptance.

claims.statement: The four physical DGX Spark fleet has passed complete production acceptance.
limitations: Physical enrollment, real serving, measured performance, live security scans, and named human acceptance are still required.

claims.statement: The local four-node simulator exercises placement, routing, drain, queueing, restart, and leak-check behavior.
limitations: It does not validate NVIDIA hardware, thermal behavior, network topology, container runtime, or service objectives.

claims.statement: PostgreSQL is the production system of record for enterprise and workspace authority, with other control-plane stores still using signed file/PVC adapters.
limitations: The reference PostgreSQL StatefulSet is single-instance and not highly available.

claims.statement: The workbench and VS Code extension invoke generic model workloads under scoped workspace authority without granting a DGX shell.
limitations: Third-party editor handoffs are typed integration points, not bundled vendor runtimes.

claims.statement: A signed catalog template can produce a deterministic plan and durable model-service operation without bypassing preflight policy.
limitations: Real runtime images, model artifacts, routes, and capacity must be qualified on the physical cluster.

claims.statement: The repository contains secret-free single-node DGX Spark qualification manifests for vLLM and SGLang.
limitations: The files are currently uncommitted and require real ARM64 image digests, a verified model directory, NVIDIA runtime support, and a production packaging adapter before promotion.

open_gaps: The inspected working tree is dirty; regenerate the coursebook after the deployment/runtime changes are committed.
